# README illustration sources

These unmodified illustrations were copied from the current tofupilot website on 2026-09-23. Keeping them in this repository lets the README render independently of website asset paths.

| Local file | Original asset | Website placement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `readme-workbench.webp` | [Original](https://www.tofupilot.com/assets/cutouts/develop-workbench-a51b22ea6d.webp) | [Homepage: build or connect](https://www.tofupilot.com/) |
| `readme-station.webp` | [Original](https://www.tofupilot.com/assets/cutouts/production-station-63b86a39a2.webp) | [Framework: operator UI](https://www.tofupilot.com/framework) |
| `readme-community.webp` | [Original](https://www.tofupilot.com/assets/cutouts/support-duo-c97a7c88ab.webp) | [Homepage: community](https://www.tofupilot.com/) |

See the [brand resources](https://www.tofupilot.com/brand) and [usage guide](https://www.tofupilot.com/assets/brand-usage.md) for artwork and trademark guidance.
